card.name: Linking words before blood-vessel or ARIA terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (and, into, with, to, a comma, an opening bracket) that come right before a vascular or brain-imaging term. Seen in amyloid imaging abnormality (ARIA) wording and in warnings about injection or leakage into a blood vessel.
